findingsAddressed.fix: Replaced two-layer design (formal authority + unvalidated bounded envelope) with a single closed Core-validated allowlist. Section 4.1 retitled to 'closed Core-validated allowlist'. Removed the unvalidated envelope layer entirely — no duplication of reviewVerdictRef/verificationSummaryRef/producedResultRefs/consumedInputRefs/failureDiagnosis/nextActionRecommendation across two layers. RunResultFile is closed schema: unknown fields rejected by Core (not passed through). Defined reviewVerdictRef target: review Run result.json (path .flowkit/runs/<delivery>/<change>/<review-run-id>/result.json, producer=reviewer, lifecycle=terminal create-once, retention=Git-tracked, carries reviewVerdict + reviewer formal findings where reviewer is authority). Defined verificationSummaryRef target: verification.md (Change-owned). Removed blockedOn (not in allowlist). Added closed schema tests: allowlist round-trip, unknown fields (full findings/verification/archive/consistencyScan) rejected, reviewVerdictRef required for applicable Runs. Clarified: review-* Run result.json carries reviewer formal findings as reviewer's formal artifact (reviewer is authority, not Run copying); non-review Runs reference via reviewVerdictRef. C1 delta spec will define reviewer findings formal field schema. Section 5 table: serialization.ts row changed to 'closed allowlist: 未知字段拒绝 (从 lenient 改为 strict)'; C1 delta row 'closed allowlist + reviewer findings formal schema'; tests row 'closed schema 拒绝未知字段 + reviewer findings formal schema'. Section 7 acceptance: 'RunResultFile closed allowlist 边界 (未知字段被 Core 拒绝)' + '完整 Findings/Verification/archive 不在 closed allowlist 中，被 Core 拒绝'. Section 8 cross-ref: 'closed allowlist' dimension with 'RunResultFile 是 closed schema; 未知字段被 Core 拒绝; Run 只持有 ResultRef 引用'.
